intro: Whether you're hosting movie nights or winding down solo, our TuneIn offers custom comfort, smart charging, and sleek storage—all in one thoughtful design that adjusts to you with just a touch.

features.title: Effortless reclining ease
features.text: Adjust your seat, headrest, and lumbar at the touch of a button—each setting crafted to support your body and your mood.

features.title: Tech at your fingertips
features.text: USB-A, USB-C, and wireless charging keep your gadgets ready, so you can stream, scroll, or snooze without missing a beat.

features.title: Hidden console storage
features.text: The built-in storage unit in the middle keeps everything you need nearby—no clutter, just convenience with clean lines.

features.title: Head-to-lumbar love
features.text: Adjustable lumbar and neck support molds to your body’s needs, easing tension and helping you relax exactly how you like.

features.title: Dual-tone delight
features.text: The Moonlight Pebble dual-tone upholstery blends soft neutrals with modern flair—easy to pair, easier to love.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Tunein Motorised 3-Seater Fabric Recliner With Right Hand Console
